en: Fixed SDK sessions giving an MCP server named by `--allowedTools` or an `mcp_tool` hook less than 2s before the first turn when settings lowered `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` after start-up
zh: 修复了当设置在启动后降低 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` 时，SDK session 给 `--allowedTools` 或 `mcp_tool` hook 指定的 MCP 服务器在首轮之前不足 2 秒的问题
